source_caption:
Cobra Kai (2018– ) is a continuation of the Karate Kid story, set decades after the original films. It follows , who reopens the Cobra Kai dojo to regain purpose in his life, and , now a successful businessman trying to maintain balance. Their old rivalry reignites, but the show adds depth by showing both sides rather than making one clearly right or wrong.

The series mixes action, humor, and drama while focusing on a new generation of students dealing with bullying, identity, and personal growth. Characters evolve over time, and even former villains get more complex backstories. Originally released on YouTube Red and later picked up by , Cobra Kai became hugely popular for its nostalgia and fresh take on the classic rivalry.
